text: {"lessons":["Selling at a profit does not by itself make a trade wise; weigh the stock’s outlook and my overall plan before exiting.","After buying Stock B and D back at higher prices, I’ll avoid chasing a stock just because I once owned it; wait for a clear reason to buy.","Small monthly declines are part of investing, and my account can still grow over time; I’ll avoid letting fear of a loss drive impulsive decisions."]}
